title: I end up HERE A LOT
content: It’s basically a giant office building. Lots of empty rooms like the backrooms… there is some type of classes going on and a hospital that I also spend a lot of time in. 2nd pic is under the building (I think) and it’s some type of time out place like a kid being in trouble… also there’s an elevator but it is terrifying it goes way too fast lol I wake up with that falling feeling. Balcony all around the building on every floor and the building itself is HUGE!
